interpretation.earliest_failed_interface: Before changing the effect objective again, the realization parameterization must permit task-conditioned row-space motion while preserving exact zero-correction carrier behavior and returning one merged rank16 LoRA.
interpretation.not_supported: This does not prove that no functionally equivalent fixed-A adapter exists anywhere, and it does not falsify ECP, a stable carrier, additive effective-update corrections, or single-rank16 deployment.
interpretation.strong_contrast: Long has the highest task-level effective-update coverage, yet all three projected members are 0 of 50; parameter-space energy and row-space overlap are not valid method-selection proxies.
interpretation.supported: The current stable-carrier A row spaces are a behaviorally binding restriction: even the analytic Frobenius-optimal projection of three known-success rank16 members retains only 67 of 295 matched direct successes and loses every Goal and Long success.
